market_question: Clarity Act signed into law in 2026?
reasoning: The market implies a 61.5% chance, but legislative hurdles like the Senate filibuster (requiring 60 votes) and a narrow House majority make passage challenging. Despite the pro-crypto administration, many similar bills have stalled in past Congresses, and true probability is closer to 45%.
evidence_points: H.R.3633 would likely need 60 Senate votes, requiring 7+ Democratic supporters amid ideological divisions.
The 119th Congress Republican majorities are slim (e.g., ~220-215 House), so a handful of defections can block the bill.
Precedents like FIT21 (2024) passed the House but never reached a Senate floor vote, showing the gap between chamber will and final enactment.
sources_consulted: Historical performance of crypto-related legislation in 117th-118th Congresses
